notes.title: In Ashes joins the first ever Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival!
notes.content:
Do you believe in love, Adventurer?


Hosted by Studio Élan, the Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival is a Steam event celebrating stories with and about romance! The festival runs from runs from September 24th-October 1st on Steam, 12PM CDT. 



Check out the festival and be prepared to fall in love with a new story this week! 



We'll be taking part alongside 200+ visual novels with romance themes from 90+ developers and publishers. 


Why are we taking part?
In Ashes is not only a story about heroism, but it is fundamentally about relationships and what that means. 



If you haven't already, remember to add the game to your wishlist! They mean a lot to small developers, especially during festival times like these.

notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day! 

 

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale has started and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, Several games are donating a percentage of their profits to the WDC to support their conservation work.*


In Ashes
We’re excited to share that Studio Ephua has generously donated to the cause!

While our story highlights acts of heroism, it also places a strong focus on humanity’s impact on the natural world, as well as the sentient and non-sentient beings that inhabit it.

In the depths of the forest, a mysterious corruption has begun to affect many living creatures. It’s up to your hero to uncover the cause of this corruption, and more importantly, figure out how to stop it—and who can still be saved.



If you haven't already, add the game to your wishlist!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434420/In_Ashes/"][/dynamiclink]
Who are WDC?
WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.



What is ghost gear?
Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. 

When a whale or dolphin gets tangled in it, it can kill them in the most horrific way, by preventing them from getting to the surface to breathe. Or they can carry it for days, weeks or even months suffering a slow and painful death as it cuts into their skin, restricts their movement and hampers their ability to hunt and feed. 

But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.

Did you know that about 1/3 of marine litter found in European seas is discarded fishing gear? That's estimated to be over 11,000 tonnes entering the sea each year!

It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  



How your support will help this year
By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring, intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: 

https://whales.org/

 

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does by signing up to their mailing list here: 

https://games.whales.org/#newsletter

 

And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: 

https://bit.ly/WODSale25

notes.title: Announcing In Ashes, our fantasy adventure Visual Novel
notes.content:
📜An unexpected quest has arrived!

We’re thrilled to announce the development of In Ashes, an upcoming choice-driven fantasy adventure visual novel from Studio Ephua. Step into the boots of a weary, burnt out hero, and face the life you left behind.

You were a hero once, but will you be again?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434420/In_Ashes/?utm_source=steampost&utm_content=announce1

A Story Shaped by You
Your actions, words, and relationships will determine your hero's fate. Will you rise again as the hero you once were, or carve out a new destiny?

In Ashes is written and designed on systems. Build your hero and find out if your actions are rewarded, or if you must face the consequences. The choices you make are just as layered as the world you're exploring. Find out more about how our systems work on the steam page!

(Find out more on the store page).

We’re incredibly excited to bring you more updates as the game continues to develop. Ashes is inspired by Inspired by Frieren, Robin Hobb, The Witcher Book series, Arthurian tales, and all fantasy media that tugs at your heart strings. We are still in the early stages but we're working so hard to bring a polished and considered project! 

In the meantime, make sure to add In Ashes to your wishlist on Steam and follow our account to be the first to experience the story when it’s ready!

Stay tuned for more details, and we look forward to sharing this journey with you soon!
